Re: U. S. Department of Interior - Bureau of Outdoor Recreation: Draft Environmental Impact Statement pertaining to Use of Off-road Vehicles on Public Lands. SPDC #72-1336
Dear Mr. Spicer:
The Floride Came and Fresh Water Fish Commission, through our biologist Mr. Jim McDaniels, has reviewed the above referenced environmental impact statement regarding the use of off-road vehicles and offers the following comments.
Our agency, whose prime responsibility is the management of game and fish, believes that most Department of Interior lands should be closed to off-road vehicle use. Damage to watersheds, plant and animal life, disruption of feeding and breeding grounds for wildlife are but a few of the problems caused by the use of such vehicles. Limiting the accessibility of recreational areas provides better quality recreation.
We appreciate the opportunity to comment on this project. If we may be of further assistance, please advise.
Sincerely,
H. E. Wallace
Assistant Director
